_comment: Tier-2: non-homogeneous Dirichlet needs AssignScalarVariableProcess with constrained=True; constrained=False applies the value but leaves the DOF free, so the solver overwrites it. Pitfall (kratos.heat #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Measured through the core process module KratosMultiphysics.assign_scalar_variable_process: with constrained=false, Node.IsFixed(TEMPERATURE) is False while the value IS set to 50.0; with constrained=true IsFixed is True and the value is likewise 50.0. Both halves matter — the value being applied in both cases is exactly why the omission is silent. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 runs the constrained=false case with constrained=true, removing the un-constrained variant that is the pathology; the DOF is then fixed in both runs. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: constrained_false_isfixed=False, dirichlet_constrained_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/heat_dirichlet_constrained_flag_fixes_dof && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
